scene nodokapostnutclarity16

scene nodokapostnutclarity15
: What you experienced was no illusion. You wandered through a gate. Or perhaps a gate was opened for you. Either way, gate. And that gate took you from there to there to here.
: But here’s the rub, Futaba — I can’t go through those things. I can’t find any. But I know they’re there because she says they’re there.
scene nodokapostnutclarity16
: And she isn’t crazy! Neither am I! They exist! We can go anywhere we want! We just have to figure out how and when!
: And with people like you and the guy who just came in me five hundred times, that should be doable!
: But, Nodoka...I didn’t even do anything...
: I seriously just...got tossed around a few times...are you sure I didn’t just...walk in here? You were clearly very busy, so...it’s possible you didn’t notice?
scene nodokapostnutclarity17
: That’s not possible at all. I see everything. You went “pop.” I heard it myself. And then we screamed. Do you remember that? Why would you scream if you walked in? You wouldn’t. That’s dumb.
: Maybe I...blacked out like Sensei does?...And that’s why I can’t remember? Let me ask Molly and Yasu. They’ll know what-
scene nodokapostnutclarity18
: Leave that damn fanatic out of this! Her fucking sermon is what pushed me into this rabbit hole in the first place and now I can’t fucking climb out of it, Futaba!
: She only knows a part of the truth! But this hole is deeper than that!
: We’re talking thousands- no, millions! Billions of universes smushed together like a fucking mille crepe and she has the audacity to claim there are only two?! TWO?!?!?!?!
scene nodokapostnutclarity19

: She did help a little bit, though. Albeit mostly unintentionally. But that’s just because I’m a fucking genius and decided to go through some older notes. They took a while to find, but they were there.

: And I’m really glad they were because the only ground I’ve broken lately has been all about Akira’s sexual history and that is only relevant in regard to this world. Probably. That’s why I fucked him into a coma.
: Akira?...
: Well, I guess Futaba knows my name now too...
scene nodokapostnutclarity20
: Ah! Welcome back. Where did you go? What’d you see? Futaba went too. That one wasn’t my fault, though. She managed to do it on her own. She’s so very, very, very very very very very smart!
: I didn’t go anywhere. And I’d really appreciate it if you could never say any of that stuff to me again.
: Yeah, I can’t make that promise. But if it’s any consolation, I took very good care of you while you were unconscious!
: I even licked the drool off. It wasn’t very flavorful. Also, I might be pregnant now. Let’s come up with a name together!

scene nodokapostnutclarity21
Futaba tries her best to fill me in on exactly what I’ve woken up to, but...I’m not sure I understand.
And so I find myself now in the midst of another one of Nodoka’s manic rants as she rattles off a bunch of baby names with my cum still smeared all over her lower body.
I have no idea how long I was out, but I imagine it was at least an hour based on how exhausted I feel and...how gross she looks.
: Are you really going to...list baby names instead of talking more about how I mysteriously just...appeared in this room with you two?
scene nodokapostnutclarity22

: Yes. I’ll begin with the first names of some famous writers since Akira and I both enjoy writing and so will our child. Isaac. Orson. Octavia. Mary. Alastair. Philip. Kurt. Margaret. Jules. Douglas. Samuel.
: Out of that list, I’d recommend Orson since it would cover both Welles and Scott Card.
: But I’m also willing to land on Philip if we can tack on the middle name Kurt since we already got the Dick part out of the way. Fun times, right?
: Nodoka...if you know something, please tell us. Because the whole reason I even came to the beach in the first place is to investigate weird time stuff.
scene nodokapostnutclarity23

: Lucky. I have to deal with that at least once per week.
scene nodokapostnutclarity25

: So if I’m not just on auto-pilot when I black out...what do you think is actually happening?
: It’s still auto-pilot in a sense. Just it isn’t instinct or impulse guiding you.
: It’s memory.

: I was following myself. I had carried this cross before. And it did not matter how many times my knees would buckle along the way as I had already reached the end once.

: I’m...fine! It’s everyone else who’s unwell! You’re all...still whole! You walk so...unburdened by the weight of your other selves! You think you’re free, but you’re not! You’re actors! Characters! It’s all happened before!
: Come on...let’s get you dressed and back to your room, okay? Your...research or whatever it is can wait until tomorrow.
: A...Akira! You know too! I...can tell! You know...I’m not insane! But she...she never had that! She never had...someone like you!
scene nodokapostnutclarity33
: Everything...I do...NGAAAAAH! It’s all...to break the mold!...To liberate us!
: You believe me!!! I know you do!!!!
: Nodoka, come on. You have to get cleaned up before you put your swimsuit back on.
: Don’t...touch me! I’m not done with him! He needs to tell me what he saw! Where he WENT!
: I’ll tell you MY story again, okay? Tomorrow. You need to rest right now.
: Akira!!! Let me stay!!! Let me stay!!!
scene black
I really didn’t go anywhere.
When I passed out, it was all just dark.
And the sound of a creaking bed, just as it had done so many times in the past, kept me suspended somewhere between conscious and unconscious.
I felt every twitch...
Every scratch...
Every ejaculation...
Or maybe I didn’t.
Maybe I just remember them.
I have to talk to Ayane.
